rule: Window engine: a window is active when start < now < end and (now - start) mod occurence is under length (GameEventMgr.cpp 36-40). Update skips occurence-0 events unless server-side (676). linkedTo: an event starts only while its linked event is active (684). Calendar rules (ComputeEventStartAndEndTime): Darkmoon Faire on the first whole week of the month on a three-month rotation with a seven-day window; building stages offset by a day or two; yearly dates moved to this year; lunar new year from a moon-phase routine with an eight-hour China offset and a 21-day window; Easter from the Gauss routine with a seven-day window. Recomputed on the weekly quest reset (World.cpp 2337). Scourge siege: zone-win lines not read (same shape as the AC donor); milestones hard-coded at 50, 100 and 150 wins; main event stopped at 150 (WorldState.cpp 1287-1299).

look_test: On a 375-wide phone: a first-Monday festival banner with a seven-day countdown, and a second stall locked until the first runs. Judge whether the lock is a reason to go find the first stall or a dead end. Second: a siege zone with a Mouth beacon, three camps and a visible win count, versus the same zone with no count. Judge whether the count changes how much the zone feels worth walking.
